title: Shareable post links with preview/teaser gate and multi-author support

requirements.text: Allow any authenticated user to create blog posts (multi-author platform). Remove any restriction that limits post creation to admins/owners only. The 'Create Post' page and navigation link must be accessible to all logged-in users.
acceptanceCriteria: Any logged-in user can navigate to the Create Post page and submit a new post
The Create Post navigation link is visible to all authenticated users, not just admins
Backend allows any authenticated principal to call the create post function

requirements.text: Add a 'Copy shareable link' button to each blog post detail page and post card. The shareable link must be a direct URL to that specific post (e.g., /#/post/{postId}).
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Copy link' or share icon button appears on each PostCard and PostDetailPage
Clicking the button copies the direct post URL to the clipboard
A brief success toast or indicator confirms the link was copied

requirements.text: When an unauthenticated visitor opens a shared post link, show a preview/teaser of the post (title, author, date, and the first ~150 words or 3 sentences of content, plus the first image if available) followed by a login gate prompt. The full post content must be hidden behind the gate. The login gate must provide a button to log in via Internet Identity and a link to create a new Internet Identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users opening a post URL see the post title, author, date, first image (if any), and a truncated content preview (~150 words)
A visually distinct login gate overlay or section appears after the preview, with a gradient fade on the truncated text
The login gate includes a 'Log in with Internet Identity' button and a 'Create Internet Identity' link
After successful login, the user is automatically returned to the same post and sees the full content
Authenticated users see the full post content without any gate

requirements.text: The PostDetailPage must support anonymous actor access so unauthenticated visitors can fetch the post data needed to render the preview/teaser. The backend getPost (or equivalent) function must be callable without authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated (anonymous) callers can retrieve a published post by ID from the backend
The post data returned includes title, author, creation date, content, and images
Draft and hidden posts remain inaccessible to unauthenticated users

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Shareable links must use the existing hash-based routing pattern already in the app
After login from the post preview gate, redirect the user back to the original post URL
nonGoals: Email sharing or any email-based notification system
Social media share buttons (Twitter, Facebook, etc.)
